commit.message:
Fix terminology: 'reproduction' is for third parties, not for authors

A paper's own companion code cannot legitimately call itself a 'reproduction'.
Reproduction in academia means an independent third party redoing the work.
What the authors ship alongside their own paper is companion code, a
reference implementation, or simply experiment scripts.

Reworded the author-facing self-description across:

- README.md: 'Complete reproduction of Sections...' -> 'Complete companion code for Sections...'
  'Reproduce in one command' -> 'Run in one command'
  'Three reproduction tracks' -> 'Three rendering tracks for the UAV experiment'
  'Numbers reproduced' -> 'Measured numbers'
  'paper-grade reproduction' / 'closest-to-paper-language reproduction' -> rendering paths
  'one-shot reproduction' / 'containerized reproduction' -> '...runner'
  bibtex title 'full reproduction package' -> 'full companion code'
- pyproject.toml: 'full reproduction package' -> 'full companion code'
- CITATION.cff: 'experimental reproduction package' -> 'companion experimental code'
- .zenodo.json: same
- CHANGELOG.md: 'reproduction package' -> 'companion code', 'Reproduced numbers' -> 'Measured numbers'
- Dockerfile: 'Reproduce the D-MAKER paper experiments' -> 'Run', 'reproduction package' -> 'companion code'
- .github/workflows/tests.yml: 'reproduction package' -> 'companion code'
- airsim_integration/README.md: 'three reproductions' -> 'three rendering paths', 'Reproduced numbers' -> 'Measured numbers'
- STAGE_B_SETUP.md: 'reproduces every qualitative finding' -> 'covers every qualitative finding'
- 11 experiments/*.py docstrings: 'Reproduce Table/Figure X' -> 'Generate Table/Figure X'
- dmaker_light/__init__.py: same
- docs/architecture.py: same

Kept user-perspective uses of 'reproduction' (correct):
- .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/reproduction_report.md (third-party reports)
- CONTRIBUTING.md (third-party reports + reproducibility-first as a principle)
- 'reproducibility' as a Zenodo keyword (canonical academic term)

All 9 unit tests pass; ruff check clean.
